perks.name: Flared Magwell

Optimized for fast reloading.

  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Air Assault
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.desc: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.desc: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.desc: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Gun and Run
perks.desc: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "For any PvE activity I will always try and prioritize recoil direction. Especially on special weapons or your main DPS weapon to make follow up shots easier. Any mag boosting perk will make the overall roll better. The usual suspects of triple tap, clown cartridge and field prep all make their appearance. Alongside our usual damage perks; firing line, frenzy and vorpal weapon. All of these damage perks are phenomenal, but use case specific. Firing line only works when in a full fireteam or raid, and you’d have to be within range for it to work. Frenzy only really works as long as you’re continuously taking damage or dealing it. Vorpal is the easiest to work with but also has the lowest damage output of all three." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "For PvP it is a decent zoom high-impact frame. You can make a choice between opening shot or snapshot if you crank up the handling high enough. Elemental capacitor will certainly help with that. Perpetual motion and moving target are also both incredible perks on snipers, one boosting low stats, the other adding forgiveness through aim assist." Recommended MW - Handling.
